description:
About ClipDifferent

ClipDifferent was born from love and necessity when founder Tom McMullen, an 82-year-old Minnesota engineer, watched his sister struggle growing up having polio, then later cared for his late wife Trudy through her health challenges. Witnessing how little things make a big difference, it sparked a vision:  electric nail clippers that eliminate anxiety, cuts, and mess while restoring independence. Featured in major publications, we've transformed nail trimming for thousands - from babies to seniors, from special needs families to anyone seeking safer, stress-free nail care.


What Makes us Different

We're more than a product company - we're a mission-driven family business. 

Operating from Minnesota with a nimble, passionate team, we provide customer attention that Fortune 500 companies can't match. When customers call, they often speak directly with 82-year-old founder Tom or his daughter, Melanie.

Our patented safety and trimming technology is backed by extensive press coverage, Shark Tank validation, and a growing library of authentic user videos showcasing real people with real transformations. We're building something bigger than business - we're creating connections and independence. 

More products are launching in 2026, serving the growing $2.8B adaptive market where premium design meets profound purpose.

How Affiliates Can Earn

  • Premium positioning: $59.99-$89.99 products with lifetime guarantee
  • Authentic storytelling: Rich brand story, press coverage, and user video assets for compelling content
  • Multiple target segments: Parents, caregivers, seniors, special needs families, healthcare professionals (approx 150 million people in US with physical or cognitive challenges)
  • Personal customer service: Direct founder involvement creates loyal customers and powerful testimonials
  • Expansion opportunity: New high demand product launches in 2026 
  • Healthcare partnerships: Strategic relationships with medical clinics, providers, schools, and senior living facilities can drive bulk sales
  • Media credibility: Shark Tank feature (S15 promo video/unaired episode) and major press coverage boost conversion confidence


How to Promote Us

Target audiences: Nervous parents, special needs caregivers, adult children of seniors, occupational therapists, disability advocates, healthcare providers, anyone seeking independence in daily care. 

Content goldmine: Use our authentic user videos, Tom's personal story, tons of customer victory stories like Richard Ramsey (@Onearmkid), media coverage/Shark Tank validation, and real website and Amazon reviews. 

Partnership channels: Healthcare professional networks, special needs communities, senior care resources, parenting groups, adaptive equipment dealers. 

Unique angles: Family-owned authenticity, personal founder involvement, Minnesota-based, mission-driven, patented technology, purpose, upcoming product launches. 

Emotional hooks: Independence restored, dignity preserved, family love, overcoming challenges, personal victories, Independence at your fingertips.
payout_period: We will pay 30 days past after sale. Returns are minimal and if they happen, it is usually within 30 days.
